title: ngrok event types
description: Every public ngrok event type and its fields. Generated by `nd gen docs` in the ngrok monorepo.

type.description: The event type name, for example http_request_complete.v0.

category.description: The group the event type belongs to: its API object, or its title when it has no API object.

filterable.description: True when the event type supports filters and selectable fields.

api_object.description: The API object the event carries. Absent when the event type has its own fields.

fields.description: The fields of the event. Nested fields use dotted names.

filterable.description: True when a filter can use the field.
